theorems.name: Submission.p09_af497904fe_cwi_infinite_diff_of_log_lower_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (ι : Type) (N : ι → ℕ) (E D : Set ι) (c K ε C : ℝ), (∀ i : ι, 2 ≤ N i) → (∀ s : ℝ, 1 < s → Summable (fun i : ι => Real.rpow (N i : ℝ) (-s))) → 0 < c → 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 → (∀ s : ℝ, 1 < s → s < 1 + ε → c * Real.log (1 / (s - 1)) - K ≤ ∑' i : {i : ι // i ∈ E}, Real.rpow (N i.1 : ℝ) (-s)) → (∀ s : ℝ, 1 < s → s < 2 → (∑' i : {i : ι // i ∈ D}, Real.rpow (N i.1 : ℝ) (-s)) ≤ C) → Set.Infinite (E \ D)
